// diagnostic

E-OSTARGET-DISPATCH-ARM

`{found}` is not an OS arm — an `@build.os` dispatch matches `.Linux`, `.MacOS`, or `.Windows`.

What

`{found}` is not an OS arm — an `@build.os` dispatch matches `.Linux`, `.MacOS`, or `.Windows`.

Why

Each arm gates code for exactly one native OS, so its head is a bare, payload-free OS variant — the same set `#Target(OS.*)` uses — and each OS appears at most once.

Fix

Write `.Linux -> …`, `.MacOS -> …`, or `.Windows -> …` (add an `else -> …` for a shared fallback).

Worked example
